workarounds.symptom: fix(cli): refuse a destination link on the `init --out` and skill-library seed write paths
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): refuse a destination link on the init write paths. Target files: agentdescent/cli.py, tests/test_cli_skill_library_seed.py, changelog.d/1008-dest-link.md. `init` seeds a skill library, writes `--out`, and (with `--agent opencode --model --base-url`) writes `<stem>.opencode-providers.json`. All three took a link planted at the destination: the spec was written outside the target tree and the `.bak-N` copy inside it held the bytes of the file the link pointed at. `apply --to` already refuses that shape (#977). (Ref: https://github.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent/pull/1012)

workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(demo): run evoskill offline with a proposer/generator stub. workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(async): report worker setup failures. An exception during async worker initialization, task selection or completion bookkeeping could terminate every worker while the result reported a normal time-budget stop. The worker entry point now records and retires those failed workers through shared retirement accounting; when none remain, the run stops with its error. Existing rollout retri... workarounds.symptom: fix(evolve): prevent queued rollouts from starting after a timed-out run returns
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(evolve): cancel queued workers when rounds time out. Target files: agentdescent/evolution.py, tests/test_straggler_semantics.py, changelog.d/970-cancel-queued-rollouts.md. Workers waiting for a round's concurrency slot could start their first rollout after that round timed out, including after `evolve()` returned. Each round now owns a cancellation event, checked after acquiring its slot and set when the join phase ends. The worker closure binds its own round's event and semaphore, so a later round cannot reacti... (Ref: https://github.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent/pull/984)

workarounds.symptom: fix(agents): define subprocess text encoding for CLI agents and command graders
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents): exchange subprocess text as UTF-8. Target files: agentdescent/_subprocess.py, agentdescent/agents.py, agentdescent/rewards.py. CLI agents and command graders previously inherited the parent's text encoding, corrupting UTF-8 answers or grader JSON on non-UTF-8 Windows installations. Agent, grader and shared runner pipes now exchange UTF-8 bytes and decode explicitly on the calling thread. A small shared decoder preserves universal-newline behavior; invalid output becomes a clear adapter error instead of ... (Ref: https://github.com/ThinkFlowLab/agentdescent/pull/983)
